{{Quote|<small>STADIUM ONE: LEFT ON USIRINE STREET</small>|The text of a sign in Eusebus|<ref name="Dangerous Game" />}}
'''Usirine Street''' was a thoroughfare located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]]. It was connected to the city's [[Main boulevard of Eusebus|main boulevard]], and turning left onto Usirine Street from the boulevard brought a person to [[Stadium One]].<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
